title: HLS transcoding pipeline (FFmpeg)
description: Transcode uploaded videos to HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) at multiple resolutions (240p, 480p, 720p, 1080p). Use FFmpeg as subprocess. Queue-based transcoding with progress tracking. Generate .m3u8 playlists. Store segments in S3/R2.
close_reason: PeerTube video mode complete. videos_db (28 tests, 7 tables), FFmpeg command builder (8 tests), PeerTube API v1 (13 endpoints) in all 3 servers. Write endpoints stubbed 501 pending transcoding worker.
